title: Timer Service State
description: Generates periodic or one-shot timing events to drive pipeline execution. (Runtimes: browser, node, python, cpp; IDs: hookup.to/service/timer, timer)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

periodic.description: When true, the timer fires repeatedly at the configured interval. When false, fires once.

periodicValue.description: Numeric amount for the repeating interval. Interpreted in periodicUnit.

periodicUnit.description: Time unit for periodicValue. Accepts any [moment.js duration unit](https://momentjs.com/docs/#/durations/): "ms", "s", "m", "h", "d", etc., as well as the rates "bpm" and "hz" and, in the browser, "beats".

oneShotDelay.description: Delay before a one-shot timer fires.

oneShotDelayUnit.description: Time unit for oneShotDelay: "ms", "s", "beats", or any moment.js unit.

tempoSlot.description: **Browser only.** The slot a "beats" duration reads its tempo from, in BPM. See *Beats* below.

immediate.description: When true, fires one tick immediately (after ~1 ms) in addition to the normal schedule.

counter.description: Overrides the internal trigger counter to a specific value.

running.description: Setting to false stops the timer. Setting to true starts it if start is not otherwise specified.

triggerCount.description: Automatically stops the timer after this many triggers have fired.
